verses.en: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
verses.pt: Naquele tempo Herodes, o tetrarca, ouviu a fama de Jesus,
verses.en_web: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,
verses.en_bbe: At that time news of Jesus came to Herod the king;

verses.en: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
verses.pt: e disse aos seus cortesãos: Este é João, o Batista; ele ressuscitou dentre os mortos, e por isso estes poderes milagrosos operam nele.
verses.en_web: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to his servants, This is John the Baptist; he has come back from the dead, and so these powers are working in him.

verses.en: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife.
verses.pt: Pois Herodes havia prendido a João, e, maniatando-o, o guardara no cárcere, por causa de Herodias, mulher de seu irmão Felipe;
verses.en_web: For Herod had laid hold of John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
verses.en_bbe: For Herod had taken John and put him in prison because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.

verses.en: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
verses.pt: porque João lhe dizia: Não te é lícito possuí-la.
verses.en_web: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
verses.en_bbe: Because John had said to him, It is not right for you to have her.

verses.en: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
verses.pt: E queria matá-lo, mas temia o povo; porque o tinham como profeta.
verses.en_web: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
verses.en_bbe: And he would have put him to death, but for his fear of the people, because in their eyes John was a prophet.

verses.en: But when Herod’s birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
verses.pt: Festejando-se, porém, o dia natalício de Herodes, a filha de Herodias dançou no meio dos convivas, e agradou a Herodes,
verses.en_web: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.
verses.en_bbe: But when Herod's birthday came, the daughter of Herodias was dancing before them, and Herod was pleased with her.

verses.en: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
verses.pt: pelo que este prometeu com juramento dar-lhe tudo o que pedisse.
verses.en_web: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.
verses.en_bbe: So he gave her his word with an oath to let her have whatever she might make request for.

verses.en: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist’s head in a charger.
verses.pt: E instigada por sua mãe, disse ela: Dá-me aqui num prato a cabeça de João, o Batista.
verses.en_web: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”
verses.en_bbe: And she, at her mother's suggestion, said, Give me here on a plate the head of John the Baptist.

verses.en: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath’s sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
verses.pt: Entristeceu-se, então, o rei; mas, por causa do juramento, e dos que estavam à mesa com ele, ordenou que se lhe desse,
verses.en_web: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths, and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,
verses.en_bbe: And the king was sad; but because of his oaths and because of his guests, he gave the order for it to be given to her;

verses.en: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
verses.pt: e mandou degolar a João no cárcere;
verses.en_web: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
verses.en_bbe: And he sent and had John's head cut off in the prison.

verses.en: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
verses.pt: e a cabeça foi trazida num prato, e dada à jovem, e ela a levou para a sua mãe.
verses.en_web: His head was brought on a platter, and given to the young lady: and she brought it to her mother.
verses.en_bbe: And his head was put on a plate and given to the girl; and she took it to her mother.

verses.en: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
verses.pt: Então vieram os seus discípulos, levaram o corpo e o sepultaram; e foram anunciá-lo a Jesus.
verses.en_web: His disciples came, and took the body, and buried it; and they went and told Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: And his disciples came, and took up his body and put it in the earth; and they went and gave Jesus news of what had taken place.

verses.en: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
verses.pt: Jesus, ouvindo isto, retirou-se dali num barco, para um, lugar deserto, à parte; e quando as multidões o souberam, seguiram-no a pé desde as cidades.
verses.en_web: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat, to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.
verses.en_bbe: Now when it came to the ears of Jesus, he went away from there in a boat, to a waste place by himself: and the people hearing of it, went after him on foot from the towns.

verses.en: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
verses.pt: E ele, ao desembarcar, viu uma grande multidão; e, compadecendo-se dela, curou os seus enfermos.
verses.en_web: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them, and healed their sick.
verses.en_bbe: And he came out and saw a great number of people and he had pity on them, and made well those of them who were ill.

verses.en: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
verses.pt: Chegada a tarde, aproximaram-se dele os discípulos, dizendo: O lugar é deserto, e a hora é já passada; despede as multidões, para que vão às aldeias, e comprem o que comer.
verses.en_web: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”
verses.en_bbe: And when evening had come, the disciples came to him, saying, This place is waste land, and the time is now past; send the people away so that they may go into the towns and get themselves food.

verses.en: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
verses.pt: Jesus, porém, lhes disse: Não precisam ir embora; dai-lhes vós de comer.
verses.en_web: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus said to them, There is no need for them to go away; give them food yourselves.

verses.en: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
verses.pt: Então eles lhe disseram: Não temos aqui senão cinco pães e dois peixes.
verses.en_web: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”
verses.en_bbe: And they say to him, We have here but five cakes of bread and two fishes.

verses.en: He said, Bring them hither to me.
verses.pt: E ele disse: trazei-mos aqui.
verses.en_web: He said, “Bring them here to me.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Give them to me.

verses.en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
verses.pt: Tendo mandado às multidões que se reclinassem sobre a relva, tomou os cinco pães e os dois peixes e, erguendo os olhos ao céu, os abençoou; e partindo os pães, deu-os aos discípulos, e os discípulos às multidões.
verses.en_web: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples gave to the multitudes.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave orders for the people to be seated on the grass; and he took the five cakes of bread and the two fishes and, looking up to heaven, he said words of blessing, and made division of the food, and gave it to the disciples, and the disciples gave it to the people.

verses.en: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
verses.pt: Todos comeram e se fartaram; e dos pedaços que sobejaram levantaram doze cestos cheios.
verses.en_web: They all ate, and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.
verses.en_bbe: And they all took of the food and had enough: and they took up twelve baskets full of broken bits which were not used.

verses.en: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
verses.pt: Ora, os que comeram foram cerca de cinco mil homens, além de mulheres e crianças.
verses.en_web: Those who ate were about five thousand men, besides women and children.
verses.en_bbe: And those who had food were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

verses.en: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
verses.pt: Logo em seguida obrigou os seus discípulos a entrar no barco, e passar adiante dele para o outro lado, enquanto ele despedia as multidões.
verses.en_web: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
verses.en_bbe: And straight away he made the disciples get into the boat and go before him to the other side, till he had sent the people away.

verses.en: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
verses.pt: Tendo-as despedido, subiu ao monte para orar à parte. Ao anoitecer, estava ali sozinho.
verses.en_web: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.
verses.en_bbe: And after he had sent the people away, he went up into the mountain by himself for prayer: and when evening was come, he was there by himself.

verses.en: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
verses.pt: Entrementes, o barco já estava a muitos estádios da terra, açoitado pelas ondas; porque o vento era contrário.
verses.en_web: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.
verses.en_bbe: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, and was troubled by the waves: for the wind was against them.

verses.en: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
verses.pt: Â quarta vigília da noite, foi Jesus ter com eles, andando sobre o mar.
verses.en_web: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.
verses.en_bbe: And in the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea.

verses.en: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
verses.pt: Os discípulos, porém, ao vê-lo andando sobre o mar, assustaram-se e disseram: É um fantasma. E gritaram de medo.
verses.en_web: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.
verses.en_bbe: And when they saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they gave cries of fear.

verses.en: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
verses.pt: Jesus, porém, imediatamente lhes falou, dizendo: Tende ânimo; sou eu; não temais.
verses.en_web: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
verses.en_bbe: But straight away Jesus said to them, Take heart; it is I, have no fear.

verses.en: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Pedro: Senhor! se és tu, manda-me ir ter contigo sobre as águas.
verses.en_web: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”
verses.en_bbe: And Peter, answering, said to him, Lord, if it is you, give me the order to come to you on the water.

verses.en: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe ele: Vem. Pedro, descendo do barco, e andando sobre as águas, foi ao encontro de Jesus.
verses.en_web: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat, and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Come. And Peter got out of the boat, and walking on the water, went to Jesus.

verses.en: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
verses.pt: Mas, sentindo o vento, teve medo; e, começando a submergir, clamou: Senhor, salva-me.
verses.en_web: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”
verses.en_bbe: But when he saw the wind he was in fear and, starting to go down, he gave a cry, saying, Help, Lord.

verses.en: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
verses.pt: Imediatamente estendeu Jesus a mão, segurou-o, e disse-lhe: Homem de pouca fé, por que duvidaste?
verses.en_web: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”
verses.en_bbe: And straight away Jesus put out his hand and took a grip of him, and said to him, O man of little faith, why were you in doubt?

verses.en: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
verses.pt: E logo que subiram para o barco, o vento cessou.
verses.en_web: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.
verses.en_bbe: And when they had got into the boat, the wind went down.

verses.en: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
verses.pt: Então os que estavam no barco adoraram-no, dizendo: Verdadeiramente tu és Filho de Deus.
verses.en_web: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”
verses.en_bbe: And those who were in the boat gave him worship, saying, Truly you are the Son of God.

verses.en: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
verses.pt: Ora, terminada a travessia, chegaram à terra em Genezaré.
verses.en_web: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.
verses.en_bbe: And when they had gone across, they came to land at Gennesaret.

verses.en: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
verses.pt: Quando os homens daquele lugar o reconheceram, mandaram por toda aquela circunvizinhança, e trouxeram-lhe todos os enfermos;
verses.en_web: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region, and brought to him all who were sick;
verses.en_bbe: And when the men of that place had news of him, they sent into all the country round about, and took to him all who were ill,

verses.en: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
verses.pt: e rogaram-lhe que apenas os deixasse tocar a orla do seu manto; e todos os que a tocaram ficaram curados.
verses.en_web: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.
verses.en_bbe: With the request that they might only put their hands on the edge of his robe: and all those who did so were made well.
